'''Nils Donald Ylvisaker''' (September 23, 1933 – March 20, 2022),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Obituary: Donald Ylvisaker 1933–2022 |url=https://imstat.org/2023/03/31/obituary-donald-ylvisaker-1933-2022/ |access-date=2023-04-10 |language=en}}</ref> often known as '''Don Ylvisaker''', was an American mathematical statistician.

== Education and career ==
Ylvisaker was born in [[Minneapolis]], [[Minnesota]], USA. He studied at [[Concordia College (Moorhead, Minnesota)|Concordia College]] and obtained his BA in mathematics and economics in 1954. He then continued his study in mathematics at the [[University of Nebraska–Lincoln|University of Nebraska]] and obtained an MA in 1956. He received his Ph.D. in statistics from [[Stanford University]] in 1960 under the supervision of [[Emanuel Parzen]]. Ylvisaker was Parzen's first PhD student at Stanford.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Sacks |first1=Jerome |last2=Ylvisaker |first2=Donald |date=2012-05-01 |title=After 50+ Years in Statistics, An Exchange |journal=Statistical Science |volume=27 |issue=2 |doi=10.1214/12-STS386 |issn=0883-4237|doi-access=free |arxiv=1207.5656 }}</ref>

Ylvisaker taught at [[Columbia University]], [[New York University]], and the [[University of Washington]], before moving to [[University of California, Los Angeles|the University of California, Los Angeles]], where he remained until his retirement in 1996. He was one of the founding members of the Department of Statistics at UCLA.<ref name=UCLA />

==Recognition==
Ylvisaker was named a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]] in 1991.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/|title=ASA Fellows|publisher=American Statistical Association|access-date=2022-11-22}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Besides academic research, Ylvisaker served as a statistical consultant to the [[California State Lottery]].<ref name=UCLA /> Ylvisaker's wife Anna Ylvisaker (née Ricci) works at the UCLA Department of Mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Celebratio Mathematica — Liggett — Ylvisaker |url=https://celebratio.org/Liggett_T/article/866/ |access-date=2022-11-23 |website=celebratio.org}}</ref>

Ylvisaker died on March 20, 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nils "Don" Ylvisaker |url=https://www.independent.com/obits/2022/03/28/nils-don-ylvisaker/ |access-date=2022-11-23 |website=The Santa Barbara Independent |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=UCLA>{{Cite web |title=Don Ylvisaker {{!}} UCLA Statistics |url=http://statistics.ucla.edu/people/in-memorium/don-ylvisaker/ |access-date=2022-11-23 |website=statistics.ucla.edu}}</ref>
